task_definition.task_description: Please check the living room main light status, get the current local time in Los Angeles, then scan the living room devices and pick the thermostat. After that, set the living room AC to cool at 22°C, and then tell me what 22°C is in Fahrenheit.

user_input.query: Please check whether the main light in the living_room is on or off, specifically the light with ID light_living. Then get the current local time in Los Angeles using the timezone America/Los_Angeles. After that, scan the devices in the living_room and find the thermostat, with target_device_type thermostat and thermostat_device_id ac_living. Once you’ve got it, set the living room AC to hvac_mode cool at 22°C, using target_temperature_c 22. Finally, tell me what 22°C is in Fahrenheit.
